name: io.github.hydradns/hydra-mcp
description: Manage a self-hosted DNS firewall: block domains, create policies, read query logs and metrics.
title: HydraDNS

environmentVariables.name: HYDRA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the HydraDNS controlplane API. Inside a container, 'localhost' means the container itself, not the host running the controlplane. On Docker Desktop (Mac/Windows) the default below resolves automatically. On plain Docker Engine (Linux) either run the container with --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway, or use --network host with http://localhost:8080 instead. Full instructions: docs/mcp.md in the repo, 'Running it -> As the container image'.

environmentVariables.name: HYDRA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the HydraDNS API, obtained via `hydra login` or the setup wizard. Grants whatever access the token's account has; MCP_ROLE narrows what the MCP tool layer will call, not what the token itself can do against the API directly.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Permission scope for this MCP session: admin (default, every tool), operator (every mutating tool except toggle_engine), or reporter (read-only tools only). Any unrecognized value safe-defaults to reporter.
